links.comparator_used: Human clinician alone (no ML suppression), with fairness also compared against the human alone
links.outcome: Collaborative AUROC performance and fairness (absolute averaged odds difference) of human-ML collaboration with auditor-based suppression
links.effect: When the ML outperforms humans, suppression outperforms the human alone (P < 8.2 × 10-6) and at least does not degrade fairness. When the human outperforms the ML, the human is fairer than suppression (P < 8.2 × 10-4) or there is no statistically significant difference in fairness.
links.tradeoff: When the human outperforms the ML, suppression can be less fair than the human alone.
links.quote: When the ML outperforms humans, suppression outperforms the human alone (P < 8.2 × 10-6) and at least does not degrade fairness.

design_hint: auditor model suppression of poor predictions
